definitions.unit: Per-photo means; frames of one still photo are not independent samples.
definitions.error: Isotropic distance between unmirrored MediaPipe pose landmark and annotation, divided by annotated shoulder width.
definitions.pck: Fraction of photos whose mean joint error is <= 0.5 shoulder widths.
definitions.wristMatch: A detected hand's wrist landmark within 0.5 shoulder widths of an annotated wrist; handedness agreement compares the adapter's player hand with that anatomical wrist.

limitations: Dataset camera: still photos through the live camera path; not a webcam, no motion or gestures

judgementTrace.hashCovers: Semantic fields in emission order plus count/overflow/repeats; delivery timestamps excluded.
